reason: NONE. The first thing I noticed was the QR and 'Every batch lab-tested' on the box, which is nice, but $29.99 is a dollar a day and I already have a drawer of half-used bottles. I would wait for a flash sale or coupon instead of paying full price for a brand I have never heard of.
objection: A dollar a day for a brand I don't know, when I can get magnesium glycinate for less per day at the store. And why only 3 forms in the Complex when others have 8 or 14 in one capsule?
would_change_my_mind: A flash sale or coupon that brings a 30-day box to around $19 to $20, or a cheap trial size so I do not end up with another half-used bottle.
